purpose: City-specific official registry/cadastre and safe anonymous parcel-geometry discovery.
assessment: An official Greater Irbid Municipality directory lists the Land Registration Directorate for Irbid city, and the DLS annual report identifies the Irbid directorate in its property-registration statistics. The DLS map interface provides interactive parcel/coordinate controls with CAPTCHA, but no safe feature schema or geometry export route was established; no form or property lookup was submitted.
registryAssessment: City-local registry evidence is explicit: Greater Irbid Municipality’s official page “government institutions and departments” lists the Irbid Governorate Land Registration Directorate and its contact number among offices in the city. The official DLS 2023 annual report separately names the Irbid Land Registration Directorate and reports its land-registration transactions. This establishes a city-local land registry; it does not verify an anonymous safe parcel geometry endpoint or WUP-point coverage.
